item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0

This update focuses on the everyday experience of using SupaSidebar, with a revamped Command Panel, clearer Space navigation, and improvements to how you find, open, and organize your links.

Redesigned Command Panel

  • Organized Results: Live tabs, pinned pages, saved links, and recent visits now appear in clearly labeled groups. See which pages are already open, where they are open, and when you last visited them.
  • Website Scopes: Browse and search pages from a specific website using the new scope bar. Type / and part of a website name or keyword, then press Space or Return to select it without losing your existing query.
  • Clearer Browser Choices: The panel shows where the selected result will open. Open With ranks your browser and profile choices by use, with number shortcuts for quick selection.
  • Better Web Suggestions: Web suggestions have their own expandable section below your local results, opening automatically when there is room.
  • Performance Improvements: Improved opening, searching, and keyboard navigation, with less repeated work as you move through results or switch scopes.

What’s New

  • Preferred Apps and Browsers: Set a default app for each saved file or folder, such as opening a project folder in Visual Studio Code. Saved web links can remember a preferred browser too.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field and jump directly to the matching section.
  • Portable Export: Export your links as browser bookmarks, plain JSON, or a full backup that restores your setup on another Mac.
  • Window Groups in Live Tabs: Tabs from multiple browser windows are grouped under separate headers you can rename and collapse.
  • Feedback in Preferences: Send feedback directly from the app, with an editable reply email and your message kept in the form if sending fails.

Improvements

  • Clearer Space Navigation: More compact Space buttons use centered icons that enlarge on hover, making Spaces easier to find even when the bar is crowded.
  • Sidebar Refinements: Compact Mode has clearer collapsed sections and item counts. Sidebar sections remember your expand or collapse choices after relaunching the app.
  • Updated Onboarding and Getting Started: Refreshed setup and Command Panel previews, with practical guides for saving, finding, and organizing links. You can also revisit sidebar setup after onboarding.
  • Arc Import Preview: Preview the Spaces in your Arc sidebar file and import only the ones you choose.
  • Save from Recent: Save a recently visited page directly using the star button beside it.
  • Air Traffic Control Suggestions: Choose whether Air Traffic Control suggests new routes based on how you open links.

Bug Fixes

  • Removing a saved link from Recent no longer removes it from Unfiled or its saved folder.
  • Web searches now open in the browser shown by the Command Panel.
  • Clearing a website query keeps that website selected, and closing the scope picker restores your previous search.
  • Reordering website shortcuts no longer drags the Preferences window.
  • Improved Safari popup filtering for sidebar attachment.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: New setups now use a browser-aware flow that helps you choose useful sites, configure how SupaSidebar opens, and reach your first working sidebar faster.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field, jump directly to the right section, and change supported toggles from the results.
  • Scoped Search Shortcuts: Assign optional shortcuts that open the Command Panel directly in the Live Tabs or Saved scope.
  • Precise Auto-Close Duration: Choose a custom timeout using any combination of days, hours, and minutes.
  • Local Folder Preview Sorting: Order files and subfolders by Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Date Modified Newest, or Date Modified Oldest. Name sorting handles numbered files naturally, so Export 2 appears before Export 10.

Improvements

  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.
  • Auto-Show Is Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar does not appear automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Command Panel shortcut hints now adapt better when the panel has limited space.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs search no longer hides an open tab when the same URL is also saved in SupaSidebar.
  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

Notes

  • Local Folder Preview Sorting applies to Finder-style folder preview columns. It does not rearrange your saved SupaSidebar folders.
